free_tier.stated: USD 0 per month plus USD 5.00 per month of included CPU usage; CPU Functions and Sandboxes are billed at USD 0.00001667 per GB-s and USD 0.20 per 1M requests. The Free plan lists 3 cron jobs and no included model storage.
free_tier.notes: The headline is a USD 5 per month included-usage allowance metered at per-GB-second CPU and per-million-request rates, not a fixed quota of compute seconds.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a function or sandbox execution, not a stored object; model storage is billed at USD 0.39 per GB-month over any included amount

retention.stated: Sandboxes are destroyed automatically after the configured timeout; the default timeout is 1 minute, and a sandbox can run for up to 24 hours.
retention.notes: Function and sandbox state is short-lived; no long-term object retention is published.

egress.terms: Bandwidth out is metered at USD 0.09 per GB for CPU Functions and Sandboxes and for GPU Functions and Sandboxes.

interface_detail: Deploy and manage CPU and GPU Functions and Sandboxes from the dashboard or the JavaScript and Python SDK; a deployed function exposes an HTTP endpoint that returns a statusCode, headers and body.
endpoint: a per-function HTTP endpoint returned by the SDK on deployment
tooling: The Buildfunctions JavaScript and Python SDK (CPUFunction, GPUFunction, CPUSandbox, GPUSandbox), a web dashboard, and Python, Node.js, Deno, Go and Shell runtimes.
chaining: A top-level CPU or GPU Function can spawn hardware-isolated child sandboxes for untrusted agent actions, and models are mounted automatically for GPU sandboxes.

limits.value: USD 5.00 per month of included CPU usage; CPU billed at USD 0.00001667 per GB-s and requests at USD 0.20 per 1M
sandboxes run up to 24 hours; unconfigured sandbox timeout defaults to 1 minute
3 cron jobs on the Free plan

limits_note: Model storage on the Free plan is not included; overage is billed separately at USD 0.39 per GB-month.
binding_note: The USD 5 monthly included-usage allowance is exhausted first by CPU-second and request charges; the Pro plan raises it to USD 20 of monthly usage plus 20 GB of model storage.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page asks for Email, Username and Password and offers social sign-up; no card, phone number or ID document is requested at sign-up.

reliability_note: Sandboxes are reclaimed at their configured timeout; the service is labelled beta (Buildfunctions v0.1.8 Beta) on its sign-up page.
confidence_note: All rates and plan allowances come from the first-party pricing page, and the timeout from the first-party sandbox docs, read on 2026-11-24.
